description: The full US Treasury daily par yield curve (also called the Treasury yield curve) for ONE date — every published maturity from 1-month through 30-year in a single call. Sourced from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)'s DGS* constant-maturity series, matching the US Treasury's own daily par yield curve rates. Use this (not fred_get_series) whenever the question wants more than one maturity at once: "treasury yield curve", "par yield curve", "full yield curve today/on <date>", "treasury rates across maturities". Pass `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) for a specific day; if that date has no published rate (a weekend or federal holiday), the curve as of the nearest PRIOR business day is returned instead, and the response says so (`used_prior_business_day_fallback`). Omit `date` for the most recently published curve. For a single maturity's own history over time, use fred_get_series with the matching DGS series id instead (e.g. DGS10 for the 10-year).

date.description: The date to get the par yield curve for, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recently published curve. If the date falls on a weekend or federal holiday (no published rate), the nearest PRIOR business day's curve is returned instead.

name: treasury_par_yield_curve

curve.description: Maturity key -> percent (null if that maturity has no observation for date_used). Keys: 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1yr, 2yr, 3yr, 5yr, 7yr, 10yr, 20yr, 30yr.

data_as_of.description: Same as date_used — the freshness date of this curve.

date_used.description: The actual trading date the curve is as of (may differ from requested_date on a weekend/holiday).

maturities.description: One entry per maturity, with the underlying FRED series id.

note.description: Present only when one or more maturities had no published rate as of date_used.

requested_date.description: The `date` argument as passed, or null if omitted.

source.description: Publisher and dataset — Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), US Treasury daily par yield curve rates.

statement.description: Human-readable summary of the curve, naming the date used and every maturity.

used_prior_business_day_fallback.description: True when requested_date had no published rate and the nearest prior business day was used instead.

title: Treasury Par Yield Curve
